purpose: We study how common obesity is in each region to better understand the health of the population we serve.
question: How many adults have obesity in each region and what is the share?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Share = adults with obesity / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with obesity and the share.
